title: feat(chatbot): retire the build chat frontend
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"hotlong"} -->
_Requested by **Jack** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzS?thread=cmsg_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzSMJK8dtC6Pva5SVajbS4V1a)_

Fixes #37682

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here

## 维护者速读

- 用户看到的变化：控制台的问答聊天（侧边停靠和全页）和 Studio 照常可用；搭建应用那一套聊天界面（方案卡、变更卡、搭建结果、交接卡、诊断抽屉、草稿条、表格导入条、Studio 副驾驶面板）不再出现，旧的搭建地址会落到问答聊天。
- 为什么：搭建能力已经整体退役，这是退役专题里第一步，只删前端，不拆分组件、不改审批和提问卡。
- 出问题会怎样：最坏是问答聊天里某个按钮或文案缺失，或旧地址跳转不对；数据和元数据不受影响，回滚这一个合并即可。
- 需要你做的：不用做什么，席位做完合同级审查后排队合并。

## What changes

The build agent's chat frontend is deleted. Ask chat (dock and `/ai/ask`) and Studio keep working; `/ai/build/…` addresses still redirect to the ask chat.

- `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`: the build-only cards (proposed plan, proposed changes, build result and publish line, builder handoff, designing-plan wait), their detectors, the build-progress mapping and the 59 props that fed them.
- `@object-ui/app-shell`: the Build Doctor drawer, the pending-drafts bar, the spreadsheet import bar, the maker start chips and empty state, Studio's copilot panel and topbar entry, and the build branches in `AiChatPage`, `ChatDock` and `ConversationsSidebar`.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: the 280 released keys only that UI read, and the zh-Hant generator's `GATE_ONLY_KEYS`, which had nothing left to leave out.

`publishHealthFromResponse` / `PublishHealth` stay: the preview's Publish all reads them.

Both changesets say the removal is breaking (`!` in the summary line, a **BREAKING** banner and `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`). The `plugin-chatbot` README, which ships in the tarball, and `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` no longer describe the removed props and fields. The ADR-0087 marker is `runtime-export-retired` for the package exports and `no-migration-prescription` for the keys; `check-adr-0087-registration` passes.

### Removed published exports, by package

**`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`** (root entry)

- Functions: `detectDraftResult`, `detectProposedPlan`, `detectProposedChanges`, `detectBuilderHandoff`, `detectBuiltAppPackage`, `detectAuthoringVerdict`, `detectReplayOutcome`, `buildProgressFromDraftReview`
- Types: `DraftReview`, `ProposedPlan`, `ProposedChanges`, `BuilderHandoff`, `ReplayOutcome`, `PublishOutcome`
- Members of `ChatbotEnhancedToolInvocation` (and `SeamToolInvocation`): `draftReview`, `proposedPlan`, `proposedChanges`, `builderHandoff`, `replayOutcome`
- Members of `ChatbotEnhancedMessage` (and `SeamChatMessage`): `buildProgress`, `blueprintProgress`
- Members of `ChatbotLabels`: `designingPlanLabel`, `designingPlanHints`
- Props of `FloatingChatbotProps` and `ChatbotEnhancedProps` (59 each, the same set):
  - Handlers: `onBuildMaterialized`, `onBuildResult`, `onDesignBuiltApp`, `onDiscardDrafts`, `onDraftArtifacts`, `onOpenBuilder`, `onOpenBuiltApp`, `onPlanApprovalPendingChange`, `onPreviewDraft`, `onPreviewDraftApp`, `onPublishDrafts`, `onReviewDraft`, `onReviewDrafts`
  - Labels and messages: `builderHandoffOpenLabel`, `builderHandoffSupersededTitle`, `builderHandoffTitleLabel`, `changesAppliedLabel`, `changesApplyingLabel`, `changesConfirmedLabel`, `changesConfirmHintLabel`, `changesConfirmLabel`, `changesConfirmMessage`, `changesDraftedLabel`, `changesFailedLabel`, `changesTitleLabel`, `changeVerbLabels`, `designBuiltAppLabel`, `nextStepsLabel`, `openBuiltAppLabel`, `planAdjustLabel`, `planAnswerMessage`, `planApproveDefaultsMessage`, `planApproveHintLabel`, `planApproveLabel`, `planApproveMessage`, `planAssumptionsLabel`, `planBuildingLabel`, `planBuildNewAppMessage`, `planBuiltLabel`, `planDeferredLabel`, `planExtendExistingMessage`, `planExtendLabel`, `planQuestionsLabel`, `planReadyLabel`, `planTitleLabel`, `previewDraftLabel`, `publishDraftsLabel`, `publishedLabel`, `resolveAppLabel`, `resolveFieldLabel`, `resolveFieldTypeLabel`, `resolveObjectLabel`, `toolReviewLabel`, `verifiedLabel`
  - Behaviour: `autoPublishDrafts`, `fetchPendingDraftCount`, `getArtifactAction`, `publishFromShellBar`, `subscribeMetadataRefresh`

**`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot/core`**

- Type: `PublishOutcome`

**`@object-ui/app-shell`**

- `ConversationsSidebar` prop `includeAskConversations` (the sidebar lists the active agent's conversations)

**`@object-ui/i18n`**

- 280 translation keys released in `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0`: 271 language-pack keys (209 from all eleven locales, 6 `console.ai.*Message` keys from en and zh-Hans, the rest with their plural siblings) and 9 `engine.studio.copilot.*` / slot keys of the Studio namespace. The full list is in `.changeset/37682-i18n-retire-build-chat-keys.md`.

## Tests

- Deleted the tests of the removed cards, bars, drawer, copilot panel and detectors, and the i18n tests that only pinned removed keys (`outbound-agent-messages`, the three maker scope tests, the zh-Hant gate test).
- Kept and retargeted: `useChatConversation` cache sanitising now uses a plain tool invocation; the `AiChatPage` runtime-message seam test uses the ask agent and a pending approval; `ChatDock` request-context pins that a build agent in the catalog binds no package; the ChatDock menu test pins Share and Expand with no build doctor.
- Count pins adjusted where keys left (console namespace, de quote pairing, count families, column-identity ratchet).

## Acceptance notes

Four leftovers are deliberately not in this PR. They are not build UI, and removing them reaches past this card's surface. The seat decides which ones to file:

1. **Builder-handoff plumbing**: `chatDockTarget.ts` (`BuilderHandoffState`, `ChatDockHandoff`, `ambientAppPackage`), `chatDockControl`, the handoff in `useConsoleChatDock`, and `AiAddressRedirect`'s handoff branch. Nothing sets a handoff any more.
2. **The plan-approval bus and the launcher marker**: the plan-approval channel on `assistantBus`, `usePlanApprovalPending`, and the pending marker on `AssistantTopBarButton`. Nothing raises plan approval any more.
3. **The surfaceAgent maker helpers**: the maker helpers in `hooks/surfaceAgent.ts`, and `useChatConversation`'s `rekeyScope` and legacy options that only served them.
4. **showDebug is always false**: `ChatDockConversation` always sends `showDebug: false` now that the Build Doctor drawer is gone, and `chatDockTarget`'s `showDebug` field has no reader.

One more build entry outside this diff: `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/AppManagementPage.tsx:691` still draws an ungated "Edit with AI" button that opens `{ agent: 'build', packageId }`. It behaved the same on main once build closed, so it is not this diff's regression; the seat files it.

Smaller stale text, also left: a historical comment in `ui/scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` naming the deleted bars, the pending `ui/.changeset/12724-plan-card-posture.md` that describes the deleted plan card, and comments in the preview's `usePublishAllDrafts`.

## Verification

Read first: `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/index.tsx` (the export list), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` (the ask-only path that stays), and the two changesets.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/ChatDock.requestContext-30043.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.runtimeMessageSeam.test.tsx` (the dock binds no package for a build agent; the full page keeps its approval seam).

Main was merged in after #37579 landed (Studio's top-left rows). Nine Studio tests conflicted. Main's new tests that assert the copilot and its AI assistant button were dropped with it; the rest keep main's assertions, and the right slot's toggle stays the title row's only control.

Two dispatch-gate fixes this change needed:

- `check-test-source-alias`: 17 tests that reach `AiChatPage` now load `@object-ui/plugin-grid` at module top. The deleted spreadsheet import bar used to load it during collection; without it, the page's own `import('@object-ui/plugin-grid')` would be paid inside a clocked case.
- `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask`: the DEBT entry for `console-namespace-3546.test.tsx` is deleted, because the code that carried it went with the build keys. `check-vi-mock-specifiers`: the `noTopBar-37456` suite's mock of the deleted `StudioAiCopilot` is dropped.

<details><summary>Local readings</summary>

- `pnpm console:build`: 81 of 81 tasks succeeded.
- `tsc` in app-shell, both `tsconfig.json` and `tsconfig.test.json`: exit 0 on the merged head.
- eslint `--quiet` over the 128 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 0 errors.
- Affected suites before the merge: 707 files, 6156 tests passed.
- After the merge, `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design` plus `packages/i18n`: 386 files, 4184 tests (4170 passed, 13 skipped, and 1 failure fixed and re-run green).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 174 files (171 passed, 2 skipped, 1 failed: the vi.mock gate above, fixed, and its file re-run green with 57 tests).
- dispatch-gates: all 42 derived commands ran before the merge. Three failed and were fixed (ADR-0087 marker, test-source-alias, the scripts suite). On the merged head, `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` and the scripts suite were re-run and exit 0. `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` and `check:new-line-citations` also exit 0.
- `check-i18n-dead-keys`: no new dead key, and 16 fewer than base.
- The full ui suite with `--maxWorkers=3` was still running at push time. Its first attempt, run alongside `console:build`, was killed for memory. CI's sharded run is the verdict; the local result goes in the card report.
- Dogfood battery (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under `os-verify-lock`, closure built first) on head `18cec5f4`: running; the reading goes in the card report.
- After #37706 landed, main was merged again: the de-quote-pairing pin is 129 (135 minus this PR's six spans).
- `overlap-check`: main merges cleanly. Two textual conflicts with open PRs outside epic cloud#5027:
  - #37706 in `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`: a count pin, 133 → 127 here and 133 → 135 there.
  - #37719 in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: a move-only split of the file.

  Whichever PR lands second takes the other's change.

</details>
